title: Crafting
content:
# Crafting

# Introduction

Crafting is the process of combining materials to create new items.
Some basic items can be crafted in the player inventory, but most items require a dedicated crafting station such as a Workbench or Forge.

### Inventory

The following recipes are available in the crafting menu in the player inventory.

• Item: Stone axe | Materials: 4 Stone 5 Wood

• Item: Club | Materials: 6 Wood

• Item: Hammer | Materials: 3 Wood 2 Stone

• Item: Torch | Materials: 1 Wood 1 Resin
